rationale: The plan correctly feeds the integer STAR/featureCounts matrix straight into DESeq2 with ~condition, explicitly rejects tximport, uses apeglm shrinkage with BH at 0.05, and states the n=3 power caveat, so it fits the design well. QC is adequate (library size, detection rate, VST PCA, flag-not-drop policy) though sample distances are not mentioned. Normalization is never stated explicitly (no mention of size factors or median-of-ratios), the reference level for the contrast is not set, and low-count handling relies solely on independent filtering rather than a stated minimal prefilter. Enrichment was not asked and is added anyway; it names the ranking metric and collection but omits a version, an explicit ORA universe, and a concrete set-size window. The report specifies thresholds, counts, and caveats but not package versions.
